verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron: 📜
“Tell Israel: Among all the land animals, these are the ones you may eat. 🐾
“You may eat any animal that has a fully split hoof and chews the cud. 🐄
“But these don’t make the cut: the camel chews the cud but doesn’t have a fully split hoof, so it’s unclean for you. 🐫
“The hyrax chews the cud but doesn’t have a fully split hoof, so it’s unclean for you. 🐾
“The hare also chews the cud but doesn’t have a fully split hoof, so it’s unclean for you. 🐇
“The pig has a split hoof, but it doesn’t chew the cud, so it’s unclean for you. 🐖
“Don’t eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they’re unclean for you. 🚫
“From everything living in the water, you may eat anything with fins and scales, in the seas or rivers. 🐟
“But everything in seas or rivers without fins and scales—all the swarming water creatures—is detestable to you. 🌊
“Treat them as detestable. Don’t eat their meat or touch their carcasses. 🚫
“Anything in the water without fins and scales is detestable to you. 🐚
“These birds are out of bounds and must not be eaten: the eagle, vulture, black vulture, 🦅
“the red kite and every kind of black kite, 🪶
“every kind of raven, 🐦
“the horned owl, screech owl, gull, and every kind of hawk; 🦉
“the little owl, cormorant, and great owl; 🦉
“the white owl, desert owl, and osprey; 🦉
“the stork, every kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat. 🦇
“Every flying insect that moves on all fours is detestable to you. 🪰
“Still, among the winged insects that move on all fours, you may eat those with long, jointed legs for hopping along the ground. 🦗
“You may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket, or grasshopper. 🦗
“But every other winged insect with four feet is detestable to you. 🚫
“These will make you unclean: anyone who touches their carcass will be unclean until evening. ⚠️
“Anyone who carries any part of a carcass must wash their clothes and will be unclean until evening. 🧼
“Any animal with a split hoof that isn’t fully split, or that doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean for you. Anyone who touches one becomes unclean. ⚠️
“Among animals that walk on all fours, those that move on their paws are unclean for you. Anyone who touches a carcass is unclean until evening. 🐾
“Anyone who carries their carcass must wash their clothes and will be unclean until evening. They’re unclean for you. 🧼
“These land-crawling creatures are unclean for you: the weasel, rat, and every kind of large lizard; 🦎
“the gecko, monitor lizard, wall lizard, skink, and chameleon. 🦎
“These crawling creatures are unclean for you. Anyone who touches one after it dies will be unclean until evening. ⚠️

“If one of them dies on an object, that object is unclean—whether it’s a wooden tool, clothing, hide, or sack. Whatever work-tool it is, put it in water; it stays unclean until evening, then becomes clean. 💧
“If one falls into a clay pot, everything inside becomes unclean. Break the pot. 🏺
“Any food soaked with water becomes unclean, and any drink in such a pot becomes unclean too. 🚰
“If a piece of a carcass lands on an oven or cooking pot, break it apart. They’re unclean and will remain unclean for you. 🔥
“A spring or cistern holding water stays clean, but anything touching a carcass there becomes unclean. 💧
“If part of a carcass lands on seed meant for sowing, the seed stays clean. 🌱
“But if water has been poured on the seed and a carcass part lands on it, the seed is unclean for you. 💧
“If an animal you’re allowed to eat dies, anyone who touches its carcass will be unclean until evening. 🐑
“Anyone who eats from its carcass must wash their clothes and be unclean until evening. Anyone who carries it must do the same. 🧼
“Every creature that crawls on the ground is detestable. Don’t eat it. 🚫
“Don’t eat anything that crawls on its belly, moves on all fours, or has many feet. These ground-crawlers are detestable. 🚫
“Don’t make yourselves detestable through any crawling creature. Don’t let them make you unclean or defiled. ⚠️
“I am Yahweh your God. Set yourselves apart and be holy, because I am holy. Don’t defile yourselves with any creature moving on the ground. 🙏
“I am Yahweh, who brought you up from Egypt to be your God. So be holy, because I am holy. 🕊️
“This is the rule about animals, birds, creatures moving in water, and creatures crawling on land: 📜
“It helps you tell clean from unclean, and which living creatures may be eaten or must not be eaten.” ⚖️
